done_when: A Done-when proof failure says that test names must be in backticks and that a Proof list on a merge commit is not read.

known.title: Not done: A Done-when proof failure says that test names must be in backticks and that a Proof list on a merge commit is not read.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a worker renames a previously named test and records its replacement in a merge commit.
The history reader skips the merge commit (`src/forge/repo.py:408`) and retains the older Proof list (`src/forge/review.py:771-779`). Since the old test is no longer on the branch, `proof.py:214-215` reports only that it is missing. The new explanation is emitted only for a `names no test` failure, so this failure gives neither required hint. A coordinator can keep editing the merge commit without learning why its Proof list is ignored. The new test covers only a branch with no earlier Proof list.
findings.title: Not done: A Done-when proof failure says that test names must be in backticks and that a Proof list on a merge commit is not read.

why: forge-pr-check reads a Proof list only when its test names are in backticks and ignores one on a merge commit, but its failure message says neither, so coordinators keep rewriting the list.
